hero.title: Science of Global Crises
hero.subtitle: Increasing global connectivity is making the world vulnerable to catastrophic failures. Local failures can cascade into a world wide collapse. The recent economic crisis and the rapid spread of the swine flu pandemic are examples of such global vulnerability.
